items.content:
The argument I keep having, usually in my head: a public library is not a
service delivered to deserving people. It is a room the public owns.

The moment you start asking who is *using it properly* you have changed
what kind of building it is, and you did it without voting on it.

summary: A public library is a room the public owns, not a service for the deserving
title: what "public" is supposed to mean
